image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of an open, tri-fold paper menu held by a person. The menu features red and black text on a white background, with visible columns for food items and prices. The top of the menu shows branding logos. A hand holding the bottom edge is partially visible, and a blurred background suggests a restaurant setting with another person's arm.

artifact_observations.location: Body text of the menu items
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text representing food items and descriptions is illegible gibberish. While it mimics the visual structure of words (ascenders/descenders), it does not form real characters or words, which is a common AI artifact in text-heavy generations.
The rightmost panel of the tri-fold menu seems to warp slightly unnaturally where it meets the fold, and the text lines curve inconsistently with the paper's geometry.
The thumb/fingers holding the bottom of the menu appear somewhat fused with the paper edge, lacking clear definition between skin and paper boundary.

Evaluate if the gibberish is severe enough to break the illusion of a usable menu. Also, scrutinize the hand-menu interaction for any melting or fusion issues.
